When checking for multiple categories, is it required that each column has at least 2 unique values, or at least 2 categories with non-zero counts in the contingency table?
Should the function handle NaN/missing values in the columns, and if so, how (drop, raise, treat as a category)?
Is the p-value returned as a Python float, or could it be a numpy float? Should it be rounded or formatted in any way?
If the contingency table has dimensions larger than 2x2, is the chi-square test still performed without additional checks?
